page.layout: Two parallel verse columns at top (left and right), then a secreta paragraph full width, then headings and verse below. Running head at top centre; page number 213 at top right.

p.i: Tu nepoti, tuo nato Carnis hoste propulsato Interventu mergitæ.
Salve pater matris Christi, Qui jam felix ascendisti jubilans ad athera.
Gaude Maria pater, gaude Joachim omnium digne laudPAter tantæ filiæ.
Iter para nobis tutum, Ut in Domini virtutum Collo cemur dextera. Amen.

main_text.p: Secreta. Ineffabilem clementiam tuam Omnipotens & misericors Deus humiliter exoramus, ut, sicut beatissimum Joachim patriarcham singularis gratiæ privilegio dilectissimi unigeniti tui Domini nostri Jesu Christi avü, & gloriosissimæ virginis Mariæ, genitricis ejus, Patrem esse voluisti: Ita nos famulos tuos, amore filiæ Patri fore devotos cupientes, tam filiæ, quam Patris sacris meritis & precibus à peccatis & malis omnibus expeditos, velis singulari dignos facere gratiâ tuâ in præsenti, & gloriâ perpetuâ in futuro, per eundem &c.
main_text.head: DE S. ANNA, SEORSIM, infrà.
DE S. JOSEPHO, SPONSO Mariæ virginis.
main_text.p: Deus, qui sanctum Joseph virginem, virginiMariæ, ut ex virginali conjugio JesusChristus

page.notes: Left column of the verse is partly obscured; the parenthetical "(de" marks a rubric-like fragment. Last line of page is cut at the foot; the page ends with signature "O 3" at bottom right, shown as "O 3" with "ftus" catchword-like continuation.
